description.value: Fresh St. Market is a BC-based grocery chain with a focus on fresh, local, and Canadian products. The Whistler location on Northlands Boulevard offers a full-service supermarket experience including a deli and prepared-foods counter, bakery, fresh produce, meat, and seafood departments. For touring cyclists resupplying in Whistler, it represents one of the more comprehensive grocery options in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Fresh St. Market is an active BC grocery chain with extensive department listings (deli, produce, bakery, prepared foods, etc.), supporting a full-service supermarket classification. The website content repeatedly references 'FRESH St. MARKET VANCOUVER HOUSE' as the default pickup location, suggesting the fetched pages may reflect the Vancouver House store rather than the Whistler location — no Whistler-specific address or phone number appeared in the content, so phone and address contact confirmation remain null. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, ice, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags beyond wheelchair=yes.
concerns: All fetched website subpages display 'Reserve Pickup Time at FRESH St. MARKET VANCOUVER HOUSE' as the default location header, suggesting the website content may reflect the Vancouver House store rather than the Whistler location — Whistler-specific contact details and amenities could not be verified from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible supermarket in Whistler. A valuable resupply stop for touring cyclists with a broad product range.
